name: usb_cold_boot
description: USB-C plugged in, nothing held: the board must come up in SPI Boot

assert.name: +3V3 is in range for the ESP32-S3 and the SD card
assert.because: 3.6 V is the absolute maximum of both; the worst case here comes from V_REF's own tolerance

assert.name: +3V3 does not sag below the module's minimum
no cited limit is exceeded at DC
the board boots from flash, not into download mode
VDD_SPI selects 3.3 V for the N16R8's PSRAM
assert.because: table 7, page 15 — GPIO45 low selects 3.3 V; a pull-up there would select 1.8 V

assert.name: EN holds a defined level at reset (RC fitted)
assert.because: R25-CRIT-1 FIXED 2026-07-31: R3 (10k to +3V3) and C31 (100nF to GND) now sit on EN per the module datasheet p.28 fig.7. This assertion flipped the day the fix landed, exactly as its old text promised it would.
